commands.command:
date -u
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
cat /proc/uptime
echo MAIN_ASSEMBLY_REFERENCE_SCAN
n=0
for f in /usr/apps/*/bin/*.dll /opt/usr/apps/*/bin/*.dll; do
 if test -f "$f"; then
  n=$((n+1))
  grep -a -l -E -i 'OffSensing|ELSensing|ScreenRestoration|ScreenOptimization|SCREEN_OPTIM|OPTIMAZTION|PIXEL_REFRESH|panelcare|panel.care' "$f"
 fi
done
echo "SCANNED_MAIN_ASSEMBLIES=$n"
date -u
